# Safe Strapi MCP

Safe Strapi MCP is a local Strapi 5 Content API MCP. The 0.3.0 source build supports schema-first entry for collection types and single types, linked localizations and media upload. Legacy page cloning/protected edits remain available. npm 0.2.0 does not include the new tools yet.

## Documentation

- Setup and reference: https://safe-strapi-mcp.metehankasapp.workers.dev/docs
- Prompt cookbook and use cases: https://safe-strapi-mcp.metehankasapp.workers.dev/prompts.md
- Security model: https://safe-strapi-mcp.metehankasapp.workers.dev/security
- Source: https://github.com/metehankasapp/safe-strapi-mcp
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/safe-strapi-mcp

## Agent rules

- Do not connect to this website's /mcp route and do not request an MCP_API_KEY or STRAPI_MCP_TOKEN.
- Use the local stdio npm package. Start from the master prompt: https://safe-strapi-mcp.metehankasapp.workers.dev/#master-prompt
- General content: list_projects -> list_content_types -> inspect_content_type -> find_entries/get_entry/list_media -> preview_entry_write -> approved apply_entry_write -> re-fetch/verify. Inspection and persisted preview are enforced.
- Inspect the actual schema, nested components, sample records and REST API contract before composing JSON. Read the returned official API documentation and frontend route/language behavior.
- Translations use PUT on the same documentId and normally the same slug; never add locale suffixes when /ar, /en or /ku already identifies the language.
- Existing generic edits require allowEntryEditing/--allow-entry-editing. No-draft types require allowImmediateWrite=true and approval of immediate visibility.
- Assets: list_media or preview_media_upload -> approved upload_media -> verify real numeric ID. Uploads become immediately visible.
- Never use browser/Computer Use, another MCP or shell writes as a fallback for API errors; report Strapi JSON vs WAF/authentication HTML failures.
- Legacy pages: find_pages, inspect_page and relevant component schemas.
- Never guess a project, field, component UID, selector, or schema.
- For clone-first operations, preview before writing; modify only MCP-owned drafts and prove the source is unchanged.
- For explicitly requested direct editing, verify preview_modify_page/modify_page are available and allowInPlaceEditing is true. Do not enable this during ordinary setup.
- Direct editing requires a persisted preview, identical patch/insert operations, expectedPageHash from pageHash, expectedOperationHash from operationHash, and a stable idempotency key.
- Direct editing targets an existing draft without ownership registration; re-inspect the same document to verify content and preserved component IDs. Do not use owned-draft validation for an unowned page.
- Direct editing rejects remove/replace/move/duplicate, clearing nonempty fields, array replacement and changes to existing media/relations. Inserted components must supply all schema fields and omit component IDs.
- Use the latest source or draft hash and a stable, unique idempotency key.
- REST is not atomic against external writers racing the last GET/PUT. Official MCP updates bypass these preservation checks.
- Use a Content API Token for this MCP; the official Strapi MCP uses a separate Admin Token.
- There is no publish/delete tool. Draft writes preserve published versions. Types without Draft & Publish and uploaded assets are immediately visible, which their previews must disclose.
- Current source previews use contractVersion 1: target, summary, changes, fieldChanges, safety, revision and nextAction. Present stable labels: Target, Action, Changes, Protection, Publication, Rollback, Approval. Disclose fieldChangesTruncated.
- Explicit rollback uses list_page_operations → preview_rollback_page → approval → rollback_page with both hashes and a new idempotency key. Only completed verified patch-only edits at the exact post-operation revision are eligible; later edits and insert operations are rejected. Never automatically roll back.
- Keep local audit snapshots private. These new tools require the current source build; they are not in the published 0.2.0 package.
